name: Moka
source:
"Chill out! I'd never let myself get hurt."

A gregarious member of the Blooms who's fierce in battle.

Her unique ability is Sap, which steals her opponent's powers.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
